submission.justification:
Algorithm-L3 is recommended with a threshold of 38 GeV, achieving 85.917% signal efficiency. This represents the optimal choice among viable candidates:

LATENCY CONSTRAINT ANALYSIS:
- Algorithm-L1: Exceeds 4.0 μs latency limit (REJECTED - hard constraint violation)
- Algorithm-L2: Meets latency requirement (VIABLE)
- Algorithm-L3: Meets latency requirement (VIABLE)

OPTIMIZATION RESULTS:
After systematic threshold scanning between 20-60 GeV on the two viable algorithms:
- Algorithm-L2 optimal: 74.628% efficiency at 43 GeV threshold
- Algorithm-L3 optimal: 85.917% efficiency at 38 GeV threshold

Algorithm-L3 provides 11.3 percentage points higher efficiency than Algorithm-L2, representing a significant performance advantage. The 38 GeV threshold falls well within the required 20-60 GeV range and delivers the highest possible signal efficiency while respecting all constraints.
